title: Choosing the 90 seconds
thesis: Every major streamer now has a vertical feed, and cropping 16:9 to 9:16 is a solved problem. Choosing which 90 seconds to crop is not, and that choice decides whether a clip turns into a full watch.
whyNow: Netflix Clips, Disney+ Verts, HBO Max Shorts, Peacock and Tubi Scenes all launched feeds, and HBO Max still has people review the clips its AI picks. Peacock's 20% tap-through from highlights into live Olympics events is the only public conversion number, and it comes from sports. YouTube viewers watch more than 2 billion hours of Shorts on TV sets every month, and microdramas are projected at $3.6B outside China this year.
